profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Data Driven Bioscience
profile.summary:
Software engineer with full stack and cloud architecture experience who strives to develop intuitive, practical, and maintainable products. I enjoy working close with my clients to better understand their needs with a goal of accomplishing efficient development practices. 

I am passionate about properly designing and developing every element within the stack knowing that will lead to a highly accepted product. 

My skill specialties include: Cloud Architecture ( AWS & GCP ), Rapid Prototyping, Web Application Development, System Architecture, Database Normalization,  and Leading agile development teams.

My technology interests include: AWS, Google Cloud Platform ( GCP ), Kubernetes ( EKS & GKE ), JavaScript, Java, Python (Django & Django Rest Framework), Angular, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Ionic, and Android Development.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
-Developed plans for migration of current application structures to newer technologies

-Established company wide web development standards

-Ported current Flex applications to Angular 2+

-Application development with emphasis on Flex, Angular, Django, SAS and PHP.

-Integrating applications with SAS stored procedures on the backend.

-Implementing SAS programs in order to generate analytical reports.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
-Develop strategies to execute team goals.

-Manage product development duties. Plans, schedules and assigns resources needed to complete tasks.

-Track the team progress and handle day to day project work flow.

-Designs, develops and supports software solution using Java, Web Services, Flex, and other web technologies

-Provide technical expertise and recommendations in assessing new project releases and initiatives to support and enhance our existing java based systems. Completes unit and system testing of application code.

-Helps research and recommend new tools and technology frameworks that can drive innovation and differentiation of our service

-Write and assist with documentation.

-Work with QA and Testing Department to ensure quality products.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
-Designs, develops and supports software solution using Java, Web Services, Flex, and other web technologies

-Lead developer for several AIR applications used for configuration and execution of the security system.

-Responsible for development of complex Java/AIR/BlazeDS configuration management suite, including database interaction with SQL Server via iBATIS persistence framework.

-Developed and implemented corporate coding standards as well as leveraging the RobotLegs framework.

-Developed Android application (ICS based) used for access control and retrieving valuable event data from the central system server to the user’s mobile device.
